id./param/scenario/cs/b_170_cs_030.pack|cs_:
"Ah, Jade... and all of you!
  Welcome, welcome!

"Forgive me, Father. You're busy
  rebuilding the village, and yet
  I've been given leave alone...

"It's fine, Jade.
  You've met your friends after so long.
  Take your time and enjoy it.

"...Once Cobblestone is rebuilt,
  next is rebuilding the Kingdom of Heliodor.
  I'm counting on you then, Jade!

"Of course, Father.
  Our beloved homeland, Heliodor...
  we'll revive it someday with our own hands!
